handover_note.complaint_summary: The karaoke upstairs goes on every weekend until 2 a.m. I want the management to fine them RM 1,000 immediately.
facts_collected: Complainant is at A-05-08, Block A, floor 5 (tenant).
Reported source is A-06-08, Block A, floor 6 (owner). This is the resident's belief and is not verified.
Reported: karaoke from upstairs every weekend until about 2.00 a.m.
Complainant asks that management fine the unit immediately, at a figure they stated.
facts_missing: Specific dates of the weekend noise, and the time each episode started and ended (duration).
Whether it has happened before and how often.
Whether the complainant has reported it to the guardhouse before.
Staff or guard check on site confirming the noise and its source. Nothing is verified yet.
Basis for the amount requested. No rule in the documents supports that amount.
rules_cited: BL-10 (by-law 10, Third Schedule By-laws, Strata Management (Maintenance and Management) Regulations 2015)
HR-1 (house rule 1, Amber Residences House Rules)
ABL-9 (additional by-law 9, Amber Residences Additional By-laws)
BL-7 (by-law 7, Third Schedule By-laws, Strata Management (Maintenance and Management) Regulations 2015)
steps_suggested: SOP-1: Acknowledge the WhatsApp report today or by the next working day, on WhatsApp. Use the draft reply below.

SOP-2: Ask the complainant for the dates of the weekend episodes, the start and end time of each, how long each lasted, whether it has happened before, and whether it was reported to the guardhouse. Do not contact A-06-08 or take any action against it until the facts are recorded.

SOP-4: Ask the guard on duty to attend A-05-08 or the common property during the next weekend quiet hours (after 11.00 p.m.) and record what is heard, the date, the time and the source as seen. Do not record A-06-08 as the source unless the check confirms it.
SOP-5: Send no written notice or reminder to A-06-08 until a breach is verified on site. Do not tell any resident a fine will be imposed.

SOP-8: Hand over to the building manager because the immediate fine requested is not supported by any rule in the documents. Note that only the management corporation may impose a fine under by-law 7 and ABL-9, and the statutory cap under s70(2)(i) is RM 200. Do not reply on the amount.
